blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Intentional dark theme with a coherent CSS-variable palette and clear panel hierarchy, but the network graph is too dense to read at render size and the thumbnail grid is cramped, holding it at competent rather than polished.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: scaleSqrt used correctly for both network node radius and color scatter radius, zero baseline maintained on bar chart, data-driven domains throughout; minor robustness gap as timeline y-scale is fixed at initial maxCount and does not rescale when filters narrow the dataset.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag coalescing correctly prevents update storms on brush/hover events, no circular cross-view updates, pointer events unify mouse/touch, no transitions so no mid-flight snap risk, and brush closures capture static (non-zoomed) scales so stale-closure is a non-issue; only omission is a missing ResizeObserver, leaving canvas dimensions and scales stale on window resize.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: Four linked crossfilter panels are manageable and the pre-computed force layout avoids reheat churn, but the 60-node network reads as a moderate hairball with only 20 labeled nodes, and the thumbnail wall collapses into a browsing task rather than a comparison.
